apps.name: Oma Year Planner
apps.description: Your whole year on one screen. A local-first year calendar for Omarchy, with no backend, no account and no build step.

shots.alt: Oma Year Planner showing the sample year: Ski week, City break, Wedding weekend, Workshop, Coast week, Lake week, Autumn hike, and Year-end break.
A closer crop of the sample calendar from May onward, with Workshop, Coast week, Lake week, and Autumn hike.
The add-plan dialog on May 12 in the sample calendar. The name field is empty.
The sample calendar filtered to workshop, with the three Workshop plans still on the board.
A translucent Oma Year Planner window over a desktop wallpaper, showing the same sample plans.

apps.name: Kar Page launcher for Omarchy
apps.description: Launcher for Kar Page on Omarchy. It opens the live site in a Chromium app window.
apps.install: git clone https://github.com/KarPage/karpage-omarchy.git && cd karpage-omarchy && less install && ./install
apps.shotAlt: Placeholder for the Kar Page launcher. It opens karpage.app in a Chromium window.
